summary: A separate wiki can duplicate source code and issue trackers, creating another surface that inevitably drifts.

points.text: Language-server navigation, generated API docs and repository search may answer implementation questions more accurately than prose copied into a portal.
Graph visualizations become hairballs at scale and can privilege visually connected artifacts over the most consequential ones.
Documentation maintenance competes with delivery time; without workflow triggers and accountable owners, initial enthusiasm decays into stale content.
